762120301.text: You stop at the top of the bookshelf on one side...

762120304.text: It's safe here. What is it, my golden friend?

762120308.text: Here, it's high up, and you can see far and wide. It's a good place to hide.

762120309.text: In our Cal{RUBY#[D]Tribe}pul, being on the ground is considered dangerous. Even if the Great {RUBY#[S]Sovereign Lords} Rulers above us don't decide to wipe us out on a whim, the other Calp{RUBY#[D]Tribes}ulli will still come to plunder us.

762120310.text: Perching on the cliffs and in the trees like the quetzals allows us to flee calamity before it strikes.

762120311.text: Besides, Vindia says that she wishes to see me fly. She wants to si{RUBY#[D]write}ng of riding a giant bird in a story of adventure.

762120312.text: Are you sure she isn't putting you on...?

762120313.text: No, no. Vindia is a very good person, maybe even as good as the Lord of the Crossroads. They're both such kind people.

762120314.text: But it's amazing just how you two flew, all the way up there.

762120315.text: This is for you. Consider it proof of our friendship. Now, I must think about how we can fly even higher to stay out of danger's reach.

762120316.text: Neither the Great {RUBY#[S]Sovereign Lords} Rulers nor the conquerors who revel in flaying are here, it is true... but I'm already used to having a means of escape wherever I am.

762120307.text: Thank you, but no, I'm not stuck. It's safe when I'm high up. Here, I won't get killed.
